 sum(case when a.n>1 then 1 else 0 end) retried,
 sum(case when c.is_success=0 then 1 else 0 end) terminal_failures
from logical_operations o
 join W on o.opened_at_ms>=W.lo and o.opened_at_ms<W.hi
 join service_routes r on r.route_id=o.route_id join services s on s.service_id=r.service_id
 left join (select operation_id,count(*) n from attempt_events group by 1) a on a.operation_id=o.operation_id
 left join fin on fin.operation_id=o.operation_id left join failure_codes c on c.code_id=fin.code_id
group by 1;
select count(*), sum(case when a.n>1 then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when c.is_success=0 then 1 else 0 end)

 left join (select ae.operation_id, ae.code_id from attempt_events ae where ae.attempt_no=(select max(attempt_no) from attempt_events x where x.operation_id=ae.operation_id)) fin on fin.operation_id=o.operation_id

with W as (select 1777629600000 lo, 1777633200000 hi)
